mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_message_delivery WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_message_channel WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND channel_id = #{channelId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_message_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT delivery.* FROM sys_message_delivery delivery JOIN sys_message_record record ON record.tenant_id = delivery.tenant_id AND record.record_id = delivery.record_id WHERE delivery.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND record.send_time >= #{cutoff} AND delivery.attempt_count > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message_delivery SET status = #{delivery.status}, claim_owner = #{delivery.claimOwner}, claim_until = #{delivery.claimUntil}, send_started_time = #{delivery.sendStartedTime}, attempt_count = #{delivery.attemptCount}, next_attempt_time = #{delivery.nextAttemptTime}, provider_message_id = #{delivery.providerMessageId}, accepted_time = #{delivery.acceptedTime}, bounced_time = #{delivery.bouncedTime}, last_error_code = #{delivery.lastErrorCode}, resolved_by = #{delivery.resolvedBy}, resolution_reason = #{delivery.resolutionReason}, payload_encrypted = #{delivery.payloadEncrypted}, update_by = #{delivery.updateBy}, update_time = #{delivery.updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{delivery.tenantId} AND delivery_id = #{delivery.deliveryId} AND version = #{delivery.version}
